column1: # 朋友收集 夢想生活（Switch，基礎版 v0）的遊戲檔案：起機中，內存與 NVN 常數暫沿用馬力歐的值，等起機實測後再改
# Game profile of Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream (Switch, base game v0): in bring-up; the memory and NVN constants are still Mario's until the bring-up measures them
# 格式：鍵 <TAB> 值；一個鍵多個值用空格分隔；build 每版一行；注釋只能獨佔一行。改內存 / NVN 常數後重編宿主；改著色器相關的鍵後按 AGENTS.md 走翻譯鏈流程

# Format: key <TAB> value; several values of one key are separated by spaces; one build row per version; comments must be on their own line. Rebuild the host after changing memory / NVN constants; after changing shader-related keys follow the chain procedure in AGENTS.md
# svcGetInfo(ProgramId) 報給遊戲的值（運行時 DM_PROGRAM_ID 可改） | the value svcGetInfo(ProgramId) reports to the game (DM_PROGRAM_ID overrides it at run time)
# build <版本> <顯示版本> <模塊>=<構建號>…：NSP 腳本只認這些構建；SDK 20.5.3，比馬力歐的 16 新
# build <version> <display version> <module>=<build ID>...: the NSP script accepts only these builds; SDK 20.5.3, newer than Mario's 16
# 與馬力歐同一套 EPD 引擎的資源佈局（ResourceSizeTable 在這裡） | same EPD engine resource layout as Mario (the ResourceSizeTable lives here)
# 沒有馬力歐那種 HeapDef（VirtualAddressMemory）：nninitStartup 把應用池幾乎整塊設成堆（SetHeapSize 0xc9400000，約 3.14 GB）。
# 別名區只需裝下 SDK 的節點區（0x3fe00000）加餘量：別名 1.125 GB、棧 256 MB，堆區 3.375 GB；總量仍是真機跑通的 5 GB
# No HeapDef (VirtualAddressMemory) as in Mario: nninitStartup makes almost the whole application pool the heap (SetHeapSize 0xc9400000, about 3.14 GB).
# The alias region only needs to hold the SDK's node area (0x3fe00000) plus slack: alias 1.125 GB, stacks 256 MB, heap region 3.375 GB; the total is still the 5 GB proven on a phone
# ---- NVN 驅動常量段：暫用馬力歐的值，拆出著色器後按全庫普查核對 | NVN driver constant segments: Mario's values for now, to be checked by a census over all shaders once they are split out ----
# 來源組：GameUber 的 bfsha 是主體；agl / gsys 的 sharcb；特效、版面，其餘 Shader/ 下的 sarc 歸 game
# Source groups: the GameUber bfsha is the bulk; agl / gsys sharcb; effects, layouts, and the other sarc files under Shader/ go to game
# 網絡時鐘按「聯網校過一次」答：朋友收集要它可用，否則先警告時間可能改變，再卡在「到 HOME 設定裡調時間」
# The network clock is answered as "synced once": Tomodachi Life needs it, otherwise it warns that the time may change and then stays at "fix the time in the HOME settings"
# Mac 滑鼠左鍵默認點哪觸屏哪：改寫器剪口讓界面每頁都收觸屏指針（dm/tools/patch_nso.py 本作條目），點按鈕就選中，比鎖定滑鼠推小手（像推搖桿）順手。玩家的鍵位表仍可改回 mouse:Left A

# The Mac left mouse button defaults to touching where clicked: a rewriter cut makes every UI page accept the touch pointer (this title's entry in dm/tools/patch_nso.py), so clicking a button selects it, which handles better than capturing the mouse to push the hand (like a stick). The player's key table can still set mouse:Left A
# 主機 1920x1080、掌機 1280x720（遊戲寫死的值，改寫器換成參數位）。寬屏時主機模式同高放寬到最多 2580（約 21.5:9）：
# 3D 比例正確（見 dm/tools/patch_nso.py 本作 PARAMS），界面畫進置中的 16:9 帶（見下方 ui_shaders）。再寬的寬度 Fl4sh9174 的 2580x1080 模組註明會崩，這裡也沒驗過
# Docked 1920x1080, handheld 1280x720 (values hard-coded in the game, replaced by parameter slots in the rewriter). When wide, docked mode widens at the same height up to 2580 (about 21.5:9):

# 3D keeps its proportions (see this title's PARAMS in dm/tools/patch_nso.py) and the UI is drawn into a centred 16:9 band (see ui_shaders below). Fl4sh9174's 2580x1080 mod notes that anything wider crashes, and wider was not verified here either
# 比 16:9 高的屏幕（iPhone Duo 約 1.42:1）：主機模式同寬加高到最多 1350（1920x1350 實測可跑；原生 2670x1878 開機即崩在 main+0x188154，像素量上限，同上）

# Screens taller than 16:9 (iPhone Duo, about 1.42:1): docked mode keeps the width and grows taller up to 1350 (1920x1350 runs; native 2670x1878 crashes at boot in main+0x188154, a pixel-count ceiling as above)
# 界面著色器的來源（shader_map.tsv 第 5 列前綴）：ui2d 內建、字型內建、各版面封存檔。不是 16:9 時界面畫進置中的 16:9 帶，不再拉伸

# Sources of the UI shaders (column 5 prefixes in shader_map.tsv): ui2d built-ins, font built-ins and each layout archive. When not 16:9 the UI is drawn into a centred 16:9 band instead of being stretched
# 其中頂點階段 cb0 前 4 行就是裁剪變換（行主序）的：ui2d 與字型內建（11 個頂點著色器都量過，x 只取第 0 行、y 只取第 1 行）。這些繪製不縮視口，改把第 0 行（寬）或第 1 行（高）
# 乘帶的比例、視口照舊整個畫面：帶內像素不變，伸出 16:9 畫布的部分（例如 Mii 走到兩側時頭上的思考泡泡）照樣畫在兩側。版面封存檔的著色器佈局各異，仍縮視口

# Of those, the ones whose vertex-stage cb0 starts with the 4-row clip transform (row-major): the ui2d and font built-ins (all 11 vertex shaders checked: x reads only row 0, y only row 1). These draws keep the whole-picture viewport

# and get row 0 (wide) or row 1 (tall) multiplied by the band's ratio instead: pixels inside the band stay the same, and parts reaching past the 16:9 canvas (such as the thought bubble over a Mii that walked to the side) still show in the strips. Layout archive shaders vary in layout and keep the shrunken viewport
# 拷貼圖的著色器：agl 的貼圖拷貝，取樣坐標 = 繞中心旋轉後的 (±0.5 + cb0 第 6 行 z/w) × 第 7 行 x/y + 0.5。教學聚光（壓暗畫面、留一塊亮框）每幀把整個畫面拷進一張 1920x1080 貼圖，
# 亮框再按 16:9 的螢幕坐標取它。畫面比 16:9 寬或高時，回放把這次拷貝的第 7 行 x / y 乘帶的比例，改成一比一取中間 16:9 帶，亮框裡的內容才對得上

# Texture-copy shaders: agl's texture copy, sampling at (±0.5 + cb0 row 6 z/w) × row 7 x/y + 0.5, rotated about the centre. The tutorial spotlight (screen dimmed, one bright box left) copies the whole picture into a 1920x1080 texture every frame,

# and the bright box samples it with 16:9 screen coordinates. On pictures wider or taller than 16:9 the replay multiplies row 7 x / y of that copy by the band ratio, so it takes the centred 16:9 band one to one and the box shows what sits under it
